description: Packaged active oscillator: a self-contained frequency source that contains a resonator (quartz, MEMS, or silicon) plus an active sustaining/output stage in one part, distinguished from the passive `crystal` family (a 2-terminal resonator with no supply, output driver, or logic - already shipped separately). One dictionary spans every sub-type over a shared core (nominal frequency, frequency stability/tolerance/aging, supply, output stage, jitter, phase noise), discriminated by which optional keys are present - the same pattern the `optocoupler` and `led` families use. Sub-types (note-only SUBTYPE axis): SPXO/XO (simple fixed-frequency clock oscillator), TCXO (temperature-compensated - tighter stability, no extra keys), VCXO / VC-TCXO (voltage-controlled - adds the tuning block: pull range, tuning slope in ppm/V, control voltage), DCXO (digital-control - has pull range but NO control voltage or ppm/V, its control is a digital word), OCXO / VC-OCXO (oven-controlled - adds warm-up time/power, Allan deviation, retrace), and MCXO (microprocessor-compensated - the full OCXO spec set MINUS the oven keys). Technology (note-only TECHNOLOGY axis) is quartz | mems | silicon; output stage (note-only OUTPUT_TYPE axis) is cmos | lvcmos | hcmos | lvpecl | lvds | hcsl | clipped_sine | sinewave - jitter and supply current are often specified per output type. ZERO new units - the second family after optocoupler to reuse the enum wholesale: frequency->Hz; stability/tolerance/aging/pull-range->ppm (a printed ppb is 1e-3 ppm - THE key normalization for this family; a printed x10^-6 is literally ppm); frequency-vs-temperature slope->ppm/degC (ppb/degC x1e-3); tuning slope->ppm/V; phase noise (dBc/Hz)->dB with the /Hz and carrier offset in conditionsVerbatim, arrayed over the F_OFFSET (offset-frequency) axis - the ADC-NSD / laser-RIN / crystal precedent; all jitter (RMS phase jitter integrated over a band, RMS period, cycle-to-cycle, peak-to-peak)->s (fs/ps normalized), the rms-vs-peak-to-peak distinction carried by the measurement statistic field; Allan deviation sigma_y(tau)->1 (dimensionless fractional frequency, the crystal quality_factor precedent), arrayed over the TAU (averaging-time) axis; warm-up/steady-state power->W; warm-up/start-up time->s; duty->%; supply/levels->V; current->A; load->F; impedance->ohm. Aging is bounded ppm over a named WINDOW (per_day / first_year / 5_year / 10_year / 20_year via AGING_PERIOD), never ppm/year (the crystal precedent). Deliberate non-adds kept in conditionsVerbatim: g-sensitivity / acceleration sensitivity (ppb/g - printed only on premium/defense OCXOs, often a typical or per-axis vector, not a guaranteed row; stored as a ppm magnitude with the per-g basis in verbatim, with a documented additive path to a future ppm/(m/s2) unit if a precision/aerospace push needs cross-part numeric comparison), power-supply-induced jitter sensitivity (s/V, e.g. fs/mV - single-vendor typical), the dynamic frequency-vs-ramp rate (ppb/s), and dBm output power (converts to W, printed form kept verbatim). Out of scope as separate future families: clock_generator / PLL / clock buffer / jitter cleaner (a part that SYNTHESIZES or DISTRIBUTES frequencies - PLL + dividers, an external reference input, or multiple/fanout outputs - vs an oscillator's single self-contained output; a programmable part's I2C/register map is configuration, not a datasheet guarantee, and stays out); real-time-clock ICs (timekeeping registers, not an output-stage/jitter spec); the passive `crystal` and 3-pin ceramic resonator modules (no active output stage). Synthesized from a 20-datasheet corpus across SiTime (MEMS), Abracon, Epson, ECS, NDK, Connor-Winfield, IQD, Vectron/Microchip, and Renesas/IDT, spanning SiT8008/SiT9365/SiT9501/SiT5356/SiT3521, ASV/ASTX-H11/ABV0225/AOCJY, SG-8018/TG-5021/SG3225, ECS-2033, NSC5318, V514/OH300, IQOV-164, MX-503, and 8N4Q001.

parameters.name: Nominal output frequency
parameters.hint: The ordered output frequency, in hertz (a printed MHz is 1e6, kHz is 1e3, GHz is 1e9). One document = one ordered frequency/grade; if the part family spans a range (e.g. 1-340 MHz programmable), model the ordered frequency as the value and note the family range in the description. For a MEMS/programmable part the exact frequency is set at order time.

parameters.name: Frequency stability over temperature
parameters.hint: The frequency deviation over the operating temperature range, in ppm (a printed ppb is 1e-3 ppm: +/-5 ppb is +/-0.005 ppm; a printed x10^-6 is literally ppm). The oscillator's headline; a TCXO tightens it to sub-ppm, an OCXO to ppb. Referenced to (fmax+fmin)/2 or to 25 degC - keep which in conditionsVerbatim. Some parts print an inclusive-of-everything stability (initial + temp + Vdd + load + aging); use total_frequency_stability for that and this key for the temperature-only figure when both are printed.

parameters.name: Initial frequency tolerance (at 25 degC)
parameters.hint: The frequency accuracy at 25 degC at time of shipment, in ppm (ppb x1e-3). Distinct from the over-temperature frequency_stability. On a short-form datasheet the two are often merged into one inclusive frequency_tolerance - store it here and note 'inclusive' in verbatim if it bundles temp + aging.

parameters.name: Frequency stability vs supply voltage
parameters.hint: The total frequency change over the rated supply range (usually Vdd +/-5%), in ppm (ppb x1e-3). A TOTAL deviation over the range, not a per-volt rate - if a part instead prints a ppm/V slope, that is a different quantity (keep it verbatim or note it). Attach the supply-range condition.

parameters.name: Frequency stability vs load
parameters.hint: The total frequency change over the rated load variation (usually +/-10%), in ppm (ppb x1e-3). Attach the load condition (e.g. 15 pF +/-10%).

parameters.name: Frequency vs temperature slope
parameters.hint: The local slope of the frequency-temperature curve, in ppm/degC (a printed ppb/degC is 1e-3: 1 ppb/degC is 0.001 ppm/degC). Per-K equals per-degC. A MEMS/TCXO dynamic-stability spec; distinct from the total frequency_stability over the range.

parameters.name: Frequency hysteresis over temperature
parameters.hint: The frequency difference between rising and falling temperature sweeps, in ppm (ppb x1e-3). Attach the temperature-cycle range.

parameters.name: Frequency aging
parameters.hint: The long-term frequency drift bounded over a NAMED time window, in ppm (ppb x1e-3) - array over the AGING_PERIOD axis (per_day / first_year / 5_year / 10_year / 20_year), NEVER as a ppm/year rate (the crystal precedent - aging is sub-linear, so a per-year rate would misrepresent it). A datasheet printing '+/-1 ppm/year' means +/-1 ppm bounded over the first year; store 1 in ppm with AGING_PERIOD=first_year.

parameters.name: Total (inclusive) frequency stability
parameters.hint: The all-inclusive frequency budget over life (initial tolerance + temperature + supply + load + aging), in ppm (ppb x1e-3), e.g. a Stratum-3 20-year total. Use when a part prints an explicit 'total/overall' figure alongside the component contributions; otherwise the individual keys carry it.

parameters.name: Allan deviation (short-term stability)
parameters.hint: The Allan deviation sigma_y(tau) - short-term fractional-frequency stability, a dimensionless number (unit 1), e.g. 1e-11 at tau=1 s. Array over the TAU (averaging-time) axis (1 s, 10 s, 100 s). A printed '1E-11/s' is 'at tau=1 s', NOT a per-second rate - store 1e-11 (unit 1) with TAU=1 s. If a part prints Allan VARIANCE (sigma^2, also unit 1) note which in verbatim. An OCXO/precision headline; the crystal quality_factor set the dimensionless-1 precedent.

parameters.name: Holdover frequency error
parameters.hint: The frequency error accrued over a stated holdover window (e.g. loss of a GPS/GNSS discipline), in ppm (ppb x1e-3), with the window in conditionsVerbatim. A GNSS-disciplined-module spec, rare at the bare-oscillator level; where a part instead specifies a phase/time error over the window, that is a time in s, not this key.

parameters.name: Supply voltage
parameters.hint: The operating supply voltage, in volts (nominal with min/max, or a range). Common rails 1.8/2.5/2.8/3.0/3.3 V.

parameters.name: Supply current
parameters.hint: The operating supply current, in amperes (a printed mA is 1e-3). Often binned by output frequency - array over F and attach the frequency and output-type conditions. A differential (LVPECL/LVDS) part's current excludes load termination unless stated.

parameters.name: Standby (power-down) current
parameters.hint: The supply current in standby/power-down (ST pin asserted, output high-Z), in amperes (a printed uA is 1e-6). Distinct from disable_current (output disabled but oscillator running).

parameters.name: Output-disable current
parameters.hint: The supply current with the output disabled (OE=GND) but the oscillator core still running, in amperes (mA/uA normalized). Higher than standby_current, which also stops the core.

parameters.name: Reference voltage output
parameters.hint: A reference-voltage output pin some OCXO/VCXO parts provide to bias the control (EFC) input, in volts.

parameters.name: Supply voltage (absolute maximum)
parameters.hint: The absolute-maximum continuous supply voltage, in volts. limitClass absolute_max.

parameters.name: ESD withstand (HBM)
parameters.hint: The human-body-model ESD withstand voltage, in volts (JESD22-A114). limitClass absolute_max; machine-model / charged-device-model figures, if printed, stay verbatim or use a separate note.

parameters.name: Duty cycle (symmetry)
parameters.hint: The output duty cycle / symmetry, in percent (e.g. 45-55%), measured at the 50% level. A range on one measurement.

parameters.name: Output rise time
parameters.hint: The output rise time, in seconds (a printed ns is 1e-9, ps is 1e-12). Measured 10-90% or 20-80% - keep which in verbatim.

parameters.name: Output fall time
parameters.hint: The output fall time, in seconds (ns 1e-9, ps 1e-12). Measured 10-90% or 20-80% - keep which in verbatim.

parameters.name: Output high voltage (VOH)
parameters.hint: The single-ended output high voltage (CMOS/HCMOS), in volts. Often printed as a fraction of Vdd (90% Vdd) - normalize to absolute V at the rated Vdd and keep the '%Vdd' form in conditionsVerbatim; do NOT use V/V (these are swing levels, not a gain). Attach the IOH condition.

parameters.name: Output low voltage (VOL)
parameters.hint: The single-ended output low voltage (CMOS/HCMOS), in volts (often '10% Vdd' - normalize to absolute V, keep %Vdd verbatim). Attach the IOL condition.

parameters.name: Differential output voltage swing
parameters.hint: The differential output voltage swing of a differential stage (LVPECL/LVDS/HCSL), in volts (a printed mV is 1e-3). Set statistic to peak_to_peak when the datasheet prints a peak-to-peak swing. Attach the termination condition (e.g. 100 ohm between true and complement).

parameters.name: Output offset (common-mode) voltage
parameters.hint: The common-mode / offset voltage of a differential output (LVDS/LVPECL), in volts.

parameters.name: Clipped-sine / sine output level
parameters.hint: The output level of a clipped-sine or sinewave TCXO/OCXO output, in volts peak-to-peak (a printed Vpp/mVpp normalized). Set statistic to peak_to_peak. A DC-cut cap is usually specified - keep it verbatim. Distinct from a sine output_power printed in dBm.

parameters.name: Sine output power
parameters.hint: The RF output power of a sinewave OCXO into a stated load (usually 50 ohm), in watts. A printed dBm converts to W (W = 10^((dBm-30)/10): 5 dBm is 3.16e-3 W); keep the dBm form in conditionsVerbatim (the existing dBm->W precedent - dBm is not in the enum).

parameters.name: Output load capacitance
parameters.hint: The rated capacitive load for a CMOS output, in farads (a printed pF is 1e-12: 15 pF is 1.5e-11). The condition the rise/fall, duty, and jitter specs are measured at.

parameters.name: Output load resistance
parameters.hint: The rated load resistance for a clipped-sine or differential output (e.g. 10 kohm clipped-sine, 50 ohm PECL), in ohms (a printed kohm is 1e3).

parameters.name: Output impedance
parameters.hint: The output source impedance of the driver, in ohms.

parameters.name: Harmonic suppression
parameters.hint: The suppression of output harmonics relative to the carrier, in dB (a printed dBc is stored as dB - keep the 'c' reference in verbatim, the phase-noise precedent). A sinewave-output spec.

parameters.name: Spurious
parameters.hint: The worst spurious level relative to the carrier, in dB (a printed dBc stored as dB, 'c' reference and the offset band in verbatim). Distinct from phase_noise (a density) - a spur is a discrete tone.

parameters.name: Control-input high voltage (VIH)
parameters.hint: The logic-high threshold of the OE/ST control input, in volts (often '70% Vdd' - normalize to absolute V, keep %Vdd verbatim).

parameters.name: Control-input low voltage (VIL)
parameters.hint: The logic-low threshold of the OE/ST control input, in volts (often '30% Vdd').

parameters.name: OE/ST input pull-up impedance
parameters.hint: The internal pull-up/pull-down impedance on the OE/ST enable pin, in ohms (kohm/Mohm normalized: 100 kohm is 1e5). Distinct from control_input_impedance (the VC/EFC analog control pin).

parameters.name: Start-up time
parameters.hint: The time from supply valid to a stable output, in seconds (a printed ms is 1e-3, us is 1e-6). For an OCXO this is the electronics start-up, distinct from warm_up_time (oven thermal settle).

parameters.name: Output-enable time
parameters.hint: The delay from OE asserted to a valid output, in seconds (ns/us normalized). Often expressed as a fixed time plus a number of clock cycles - keep the formula in verbatim.

parameters.name: Output-disable time
parameters.hint: The delay from OE de-asserted to the output high-Z, in seconds.

parameters.name: Resume time (from standby)
parameters.hint: The time to a valid output after exiting standby (ST released), in seconds.

parameters.name: Time to rated frequency stability
parameters.hint: The time from power-on to the first output pulse that meets the rated frequency stability, in seconds (distinct from startup_time = first pulse of ANY accuracy). A TCXO/OCXO spec.

parameters.name: RMS phase jitter (integrated)
parameters.hint: The RMS phase jitter integrated over a stated offset band, in seconds (a printed fs is 1e-15, ps is 1e-12: 100 fs is 1e-13). statistic=rms. Array over the INTEG_BW (integration-band) axis when several bands are printed (12 kHz-20 MHz, 1.875-20 MHz mask, 4/16 MHz filters) - keep the exact band and carrier in conditionsVerbatim. THE low-jitter-oscillator headline.

parameters.name: RMS period jitter
parameters.hint: The RMS period jitter (1-sigma cycle-to-average deviation), in seconds (ps 1e-12). statistic=rms. Attach the sample population and carrier (e.g. 10k cycles, JESD65B) in verbatim.

parameters.name: Cycle-to-cycle jitter
parameters.hint: The cycle-to-cycle jitter (adjacent-period deviation), in seconds (ps 1e-12). Usually a peak figure - set statistic to peak when so printed.

parameters.name: Peak-to-peak period jitter
parameters.hint: The peak-to-peak period jitter over a stated sample population, in seconds (ps 1e-12). statistic=peak_to_peak.

parameters.name: SSB phase noise
parameters.hint: The single-sideband phase noise L(f), in dB - store the printed dBc/Hz magnitude as a dB value (e.g. -145) and keep the '/Hz' and the carrier ('@ 10 MHz, Vdd=3.3V') in conditionsVerbatim (the ADC dBFS/Hz, laser RIN, crystal precedent - no dBc/Hz unit). Array over the F_OFFSET (carrier-offset) axis - one measurement per offset (1 Hz, 10 Hz, 100 Hz, 1 kHz, 10 kHz, 100 kHz, 1 MHz). If a part also sweeps phase noise over carrier-frequency band, emit one document per band or keep the band verbatim.

parameters.name: Absolute pull range (APR)
parameters.hint: The VCXO/DCXO guaranteed pull range AFTER subtracting stability and aging, in ppm (the industry headline: APR = pull_range - frequency_stability - aging). Referenced to the nominal frequency. Present on VCXO and DCXO; a DCXO has APR but no control_voltage_range or tuning_slope.

parameters.name: Frequency pull range
parameters.hint: The total frequency deviation over the full control range (full Vc sweep, or full digital-word range for a DCXO), in ppm. The raw range before stability/aging are subtracted (that is absolute_pull_range).

parameters.name: Pullability at stated control voltage
parameters.hint: The frequency pull at a stated symmetric control-voltage excursion (e.g. +/-200 ppm at Vc=1.65V +/-1.65V), in ppm. Distinguished from pull_range/APR by its conditions.

parameters.name: Tuning slope (KV)
parameters.hint: The VCXO frequency-vs-control-voltage slope KV, in ppm/V (already in the enum; a printed ppm/V is stored as-is, e.g. 150). The VCXO headline; where a part prints only a pull range and a Vc range, KV = pull_range / Vc_range (derived). A DCXO has no KV (digital control). Sign/polarity is note-only (tuning_polarity).

parameters.name: Control-voltage (EFC) range
parameters.hint: The control-voltage (EFC) input range over which the pull range is guaranteed, in volts. Present on VCXO/VC-TCXO/VC-OCXO; absent on a DCXO (digital control word) and a plain XO/TCXO/OCXO.

parameters.name: Control-voltage bias (center)
parameters.hint: The control voltage at which the nominal (un-pulled) frequency holds, in volts (e.g. Vc = 1.65 V = Vdd/2). The bias point the pull range is referenced to.

parameters.name: Control-input impedance
parameters.hint: The input impedance of the VC/EFC control pin, in ohms (kohm/Mohm normalized: 100 kohm is 1e5, 2 Mohm is 2e6). Distinct from oe_input_impedance (the digital OE pin).

parameters.name: Control (modulation) bandwidth
parameters.hint: The -3 dB bandwidth of the control (VC) input's frequency-modulation response, in hertz (a printed kHz is 1e3). A VCXO spec.

parameters.name: Tuning linearity
parameters.hint: The deviation of the pull-vs-control-voltage curve from a best-fit line, in percent (e.g. +/-10%). A DCXO is 'perfect' (digital) - omit rather than store 0.

parameters.name: Control voltage (absolute maximum)
parameters.hint: The absolute-maximum voltage on the VC/EFC control pin, in volts (e.g. -0.5 to 7, or -0.5 to Vcc+0.5). limitClass absolute_max. The structural sibling of absolute_max_supply_voltage; distinct from control_voltage_range (the guaranteed-pull OPERATING range).

parameters.name: Warm-up time (OCXO)
parameters.hint: The time for an OCXO oven to reach a stated frequency accuracy after turn-on, in seconds (a printed minute is 60 s: 3 min is 180). Keep the accuracy criterion (e.g. within +/-100 ppb) in verbatim. Absent on an MCXO (compensated, not ovenized) - its presence is the OCXO tell.

parameters.name: Warm-up power (OCXO)
parameters.hint: The peak power the OCXO oven draws during warm-up, in watts (a printed mW is 1e-3). limitClass absolute_max or recommended per how it is framed.

parameters.name: Steady-state power (OCXO)
parameters.hint: The OCXO steady-state (oven-maintained) power at a stated ambient (usually 25 degC), in watts. Lower than warm_up_power.

parameters.name: Warm-up frequency accuracy (OCXO)
parameters.hint: The frequency accuracy an OCXO reaches within its warm-up time, in ppm (ppb x1e-3), referenced to the final stabilized frequency. Attach the warm-up time as a condition.

parameters.name: Retrace (re-stabilization frequency offset)
parameters.hint: The frequency offset an OCXO returns to after an off/on power cycle, relative to before, in ppm (ppb x1e-3), for a stated off-time. If a part instead tabulates a re-stabilization TIME vs off-time, that is a time (s) - keep the table in verbatim.

parameters.name: Acceleration (g) sensitivity
parameters.hint: The fractional-frequency shift per unit acceleration (Delta-f/f per g), stored as the ppm MAGNITUDE with the per-g basis, axis (x/y/z or vector sum), and any vibration-profile band kept in conditionsVerbatim (e.g. '0.3 ppb/g, worst axis, 10-250 Hz' -> value 0.0003 ppm). A premium/defense-OCXO spec, deliberately NOT given a per-acceleration unit (ppb/g is not SI); if a future precision/aerospace push needs numeric cross-part comparison, the additive path is a ppm/(m/s2) unit with fixtures - the deferred-unit precedent (like lux/W-m2 for photodiode).

parameters.name: Operating temperature range
parameters.hint: The operating (ambient) temperature range, in degC. Model as a min and max on one measurement. The range the frequency_stability is guaranteed over.

parameters.name: Storage temperature range
parameters.hint: The storage temperature range, in degC. limitClass absolute_max.

parameters.name: Peak soldering (reflow) temperature
parameters.hint: The peak reflow/soldering temperature the package withstands, in degC (e.g. 260). limitClass absolute_max; keep the JEDEC J-STD-020 profile reference in conditionsVerbatim. A permanent post-reflow frequency SHIFT, if a part prints one as a guaranteed ppm row, is a separate quantity (kept verbatim for now, per the crystal reflow-TEST precedent).

parameters.name: Junction temperature (abs max)
parameters.hint: The maximum junction temperature, in degC (MEMS/silicon parts). limitClass absolute_max.

parameters.name: Thermal resistance, junction-to-ambient
parameters.hint: The junction-to-ambient thermal resistance, in degC/W (equal to K/W). Reference data on MEMS parts.

parameters.name: Thermal resistance, junction-to-case
parameters.hint: The junction-to-case thermal resistance, in degC/W (= K/W).
